5 ترمّمهُ He proceeded gradually, by degrees, step by step, or time after time, with the repairing of it; or with the putting it into a good, sound, right, or proper, state. (TA.) ＝
-A2- See also 1, near the middle of the paragraph, in two places.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
